initial_overlay: R1 verified contradictions, correction/retraction, halt, feed health and official macro-calendar blackout; unknown required context abstains

hypotheses.H1: Comparable positive quantitative management guidance revision; minimum midpoint increase 1%, both endpoints nondecreasing; not consensus surprise.
hypotheses.H2: New binding valued contract, known 1-60 month duration, total lifetime value at least 5% of point-in-time reported annual GAAP revenue; lifetime value is not near-term revenue, earnings or profit.
hypotheses.economic_mechanism: Guidance may change expected company cash flows; binding contracts may change future sales scale. Remaining post-arrival return is unknown, not presumed positive.

fallback: Conservative deterministic source-span grammar; optional model JSON must exactly agree with independently parsed facts. Unknowns remain null.
source_limitations: Alpaca provider symbols are candidates only. Articles are not issuer-authoritative evidence.
News full-text retention defaults disabled until an explicit account-permitted rights profile is configured.
Only independently configured primary URLs or SEC CIK-scoped submission metadata authorize requests; article links never authorize network access.
SEC acceptance timestamps are retained separately and never substituted for definitive first-publication timestamps.
Original historical revisions and delivery times are not reconstructed from a current article body.
Only current fixed AAPL/MSFT/NVDA identities are supplied; mapping availability begins 2026-09-06, not a historical point-in-time universe.

timing.source_receipt: Actual local post-response UTC time. Preserve immutable versions and seed recorded evidence on restart.
timing.premarket: No entry until a completed regular-session five-minute observation after availability. Same 30-minute source expiry applies: older overnight/premarket evidence expires rather than being relabelled fresh.
timing.quote: A raw-price quote at or after computed eligible_at, no older than five seconds, with recorded share-size units. IEX is explicitly non-NBBO.
timing.exit: 60 minutes after decision and at least 10 minutes before supplied verified session close. No overnight extension.
timing.macro: Calendar must cover the full horizon. Block when a scheduled release is between 30 minutes before decision and 30 minutes after the planned exit.
timing.order_authority: Domain eligibility is not broker permission; external persistent idempotency, current operational certificate, stricter legacy limits, live-disabled broker isolation and independent risk approval remain mandatory.

performance_claim: No calibrated probability, expectation, return forecast, historical alpha or profitability claim is supplied.
